anchors.label: DEBT_SECTION
anchors.regex: ^(?!.*\bType of Investment\b)Portfolio Company Debt Securities(?:- (?:United Sates|United States|Canada|Europe)(?: [^;]+)?)?$

evidence.observation: 2026-03-31 bundle samples embed Prime, Base Rate, and SOFR term reference-rate clauses.
Oldest bundle era embeds Prime and older SOFR/LIBOR-style reference-rate clauses.
Debt identifiers embed Interest Rate, Variable interest rate, or Fixed interest rate text.
Bundle samples use Warrant Investments- while all none_examples use Warrant Investments without the hyphen, including an en-dash geography separator.
